name: 30" Electric Cooktop with 5 Elements and Knob Controls

productFeature.description: Provides greater versatility for high and low temperature cooking techniques. Even-Heat™ Technology maintains a constant supply of power and delivers a range of simmer settings.
productFeature.title: 10'' Even-Heat™ Ultra Power™ Element with Simmer Setting

productFeature.description: Combines the benefits of Even-Heat™ Technology with a dedicated setting that reaches the low temperatures needed to melt chocolate or butter without scorching.
productFeature.title: 6'' Even-Heat™ Element with Melt Setting

productFeature.description: Combines two element sizes in one, making it a perfect fit for large stock pots or six-inch sauté pans alike, and ideal for a wide range of tasks from rapid boiling and searing to wok cooking.
productFeature.title: 10''/6'' Ultra Power™ Double-Ring Round Element

productFeature.description: Efficiently heats a variety of pan sizes and can reach a power output of up to 1800-watts for every day use.
productFeature.title: 8'' 1800-Watt Round Element

productFeature.description: Can reach a power output of up to 1200-watts to handle your daily cooking needs.
productFeature.title: 6'' 1200-Watt Round Element

productFeature.description: Protects you by providing a visual indication if a cooking surface is on or still hot, so you can create with confidence.
productFeature.title: Hot Surface Indicator

productFeature.description: Substantial, professionally-inspired stainless steel knobs easily adjust the cooktop's elements through an infinite number of heat settings, offering responsiveness and flexibility in control.
productFeature.title: Metal Control Knobs

productFeature.description: Disables cooking mode for easy cleaning when not in use.
productFeature.title: Control Lock
